name: arthatula-promo-video
description: Promo video for Arthatula, made with Remotion. Not part of the app.

scripts.shots:setup: mkdir -p public/shots && node setup-shots.mjs .. public/shots && sips -s format png ../docs/screenshots/phone-home.webp --out public/shots/phone-home.png
scripts.render: remotion render src/index.jsx Promo-16x9 out/arthatula-16x9.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=20 --enforce-audio-track && remotion render src/index.jsx Promo-1x1 out/arthatula-1x1.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=20 --enforce-audio-track && remotion render src/index.jsx Promo-9x16 out/arthatula-9x16.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=20 --enforce-audio-track
